queries.natural_language_query: SELECT position, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY position
queries.sql:
SELECT "t2"."position", AVG("t2"."age") AS "avg_age"
FROM "player" AS "t2"
WHERE ("t2"."position" = 'Frontcourt' OR "t2"."position" = 'Backcourt')
GROUP BY "t2"."position"

queries.natural_language_query: SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE age BETWEEN 20 AND 40 AND nationality != '' GROUP BY nationality
queries.sql:
SELECT "t2"."nationality", COUNT(*) AS "player_count"
FROM "player" AS "t2"
WHERE (("t2"."age" >= 20 AND "t2"."age" <= 40) AND "t2"."nationality" != '')
GROUP BY "t2"."nationality"
